findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "export_owl" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Export project schema as an OWL ontology (Turtle): owl:Class per Type, Datatype/ObjectProperty per Element with domain/range, rdfs:subClassOf inheritance, cardi…

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "run_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_comments, whoami · Private data: validate_json, query_model_graphql, whoami, export_owl, export_rml, transform_schema, contact_sales · Public sink: whoami, contact_sales · Destructive: export_json_ld, check_admissible, get_mixins_and_relation_groups, list_projects, query_model_graphql, search_nodes, export_rml, transform_schema, run_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_comments, whoami · Private data: validate_json, query_model_graphql, whoami, export_owl, export_rml, transform_schema, contact_sales · Public sink: whoami, contact_sales · Destructive: export_json_ld, check_admissible, get_mixins_and_relation_groups, list_projects, query_model_graphql, search_nodes, export_rml, transform_schema, run_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
